name: Archer Push-Up
instructions: Begin in a push-up position with hands placed wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep one arm straight and extended to the side as you lower your body.
Bend the opposite arm and lower your chest toward that hand.
The extended arm should remain relatively straight, supporting minimal weight.
Push back up through the bent arm to return to the starting position.
Keep your core tight and body in a straight line throughout.
This movement resembles drawing a bow and arrow, hence the name.
